details.description: moonshot-v1-32k-vision-preview was the 32,768-token-context, image-input variant of Moonshot AI's original moonshot-v1 chat-completions line, adding vision (image plus text input, text output) alongside the text-only moonshot-v1-32k model. Moonshot AI's platform changelog records launching a moonshot-v1-vision-preview model in January 2025. Moonshot AI's developer platform, now operating under the Kimi brand at platform.kimi.ai, discontinued the entire moonshot-v1 series, including this vision-preview variant, on August 31, 2026, stating it is no longer maintained or supported and directing developers to its current flagship model, kimi-k3.
advantages: Combined image input with a larger 32,768-token context window than the series' moonshot-v1-8k-vision-preview tier, per Moonshot AI's own model documentation.
disadvantages: Moonshot AI discontinued moonshot-v1-32k-vision-preview, along with the rest of the moonshot-v1 series, on August 31, 2026, stating it is no longer maintained or supported and recommending kimi-k3 instead.
Retained a 'preview' label in its model name throughout its documented lifetime, per Moonshot AI's changelog and model list.
use_cases: Chat completions combining image and text input over a longer 32,768-token context than the 8k-vision-preview tier, as part of Moonshot AI's original moonshot-v1 vision-preview line before its August 2026 retirement.

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date fact is empty for this target, but Moonshot AI's own Model List and platform changelog (both fetched 2026-09-24) state the entire moonshot-v1 series, including its vision-preview variants, was discontinued on 2026-08-31 and that calls to it now return a 404 error. The changelog records launching 'moonshot-v1-vision-preview' in January 2025 without separately naming a 32k tier at that time; the current Model List's deprecated-models table does name moonshot-v1-32k-vision-preview specifically, alongside moonshot-v1-8k-vision-preview and moonshot-v1-128k-vision-preview. No source describing this model's specific vision capabilities (e.g. max image size, supported formats) beyond taking image input was found; modality here matches the catalog facts. Context window (32,768 tokens) matches the catalog facts.
